name: Grand Widow Faerlina
notes: Numbers follow docs/research/naxxramas/faerlina.md (1,312,027 HP classicdb; the wiki gives no HP). HP is a clock over 270 s (estimate; Warcraft Tavern says under 4:00, the wiki's soft limit is about 4:45). The cathedral layout, every coordinate and the Follower and Worshipper positions are estimates from the guides' prose. ENRAGE on its real timer: DBM-Vanilla's first Enrage at about 56 s and then a 56 to 76 s variable timer; guides say every 60 s. In DBM's Lua an Embrace on an enraged boss restarts that timer, and an early Embrace only stops the bar. Here it is a FIXED 60 s cycle (first at 56 s, no jitter) so the 30 s Poison Bolt Volley silence after each Embrace can line up with it; a variable timer would need the engine to re-time actions after a removal. The real Enrage is +75% attack speed and +150 damage per the tooltip (effect data says 150%, research open question), which is roughly +200 to +350% DPS on the tank. THE WORSHIPPER SACRIFICE IS THE REMOVAL JOB. It is the healer role's Dispel button, standing in for the Mind Controlling Priest's Widow's Embrace: Enrage is a `debuff` on the tank (`dispel: enrage`, `damageTakenMult` 1.5, 55 s until the next one) that only the healer's `dispels` list can remove. Press Dispel the moment it lands. A healer who ignores it loses the tank, because the ghost's passive healing with a player healer is 140 per second. Faerlina's real counter is the Worshipper count: four, one per Enrage. The script's clock ends after four Enrages at 236 s, before a fifth is due, so the fifth Enrage (which would stay on her permanently) is not simulated. Two real rules are missing: an Embrace before Enrage only delays it 30 s (wiki), and a Worshipper must be within 15 yd of her and the Mind Control can be resisted (the main wipe cause in Method's recollection). The player cannot get these wrong here; the job is timing the press after the Enrage toast. The boss's own damage increase is a `kind: enrage` with an 8 s duration (`enrageMultiplier` 1.6 on melee) for every role, representing the seconds before the Embrace lands; it fires alongside the debuff. Followers are `killFirst` adds, 98,238 HP each, lifetimes 25 and 30 s (estimate of raid DPS); their AoE Silence and Charge are not modelled (no add abilities in the engine); the off-tank picks one up at the pull. Worshippers are four non-killable adds parked in the corner for display; in the real fight an off-tank holds them and the raid never touches them. The player cannot attack them here (`killable` false), so the real rule 'do not hit a Worshipper' is not scored. POISON BOLT VOLLEY: `debuff` 300 per second for 10 s (real 413 to 587 per 2 s), playerChance 0.25 (real: about 10 of 40 raiders); the initial 1,313 hit is folded into the DoT because a debuff has no direct damage. Poison dispel. Cadence every 12 s is an estimate; only Wrath-era Ten Ton Hammer says 15 s; Classic sources give no timer. Widow's Embrace silences her Nature school for 30 s, modelled by scheduling no Volley in the 30 s after each Enrage (fixed windows, because the engine cannot pause an action when a debuff is removed). RAIN OF FIRE: telegraphed 10 yd zone (spell radius), 2 s warning (a reaction time; the real one has no telegraph but the zone appears on cast), 6 s, 1,000 per second (real 1,850 to 2,150 per 2 s), cadence every 14 s estimated ('frequent'); a second copy on the tank's position every 42 s so the tank has to drag her out of it. Damage is scaled to a 10,000 HP tank, so a tank survives normal play but dies if the healer ignores a spike. Her melee is 1,300 per 2 s (classicdb 8,475 to 9,727 pre-mitigation, swing estimated 2 s): with no healing and no Enrage removal the tank dies in about 20 s, and an Enrage that is not removed multiplies it again. Non-healer roles have a generous passive heal (1,900 per second) so the Enrage debuff that nobody can remove in those roles does not kill the ghost.

raidCenter.label: Raid: spread out for the fire

healerSpot.label: Healers: spread, in range of the tank

tank.label: Main tank
tank.description: Pull Faerlina away from the adds to the west side. Keep her there, move her out of any Rain of Fire she stands in, and be ready for a huge spike every time she Enrages until the Priests sacrifice a Worshipper.

offtank.label: Add tank
offtank.description: Grab a Follower on the pull and hold it near the raid so the DPS can kill it. When the Followers are dead, go and stand with the Worshipper corner and keep the Worshippers on you, far from everyone, for the whole fight.

melee.label: Melee DPS
melee.description: Kill the Followers first, then stand behind her. Step out of Rain of Fire instantly: it hits for over 2,000 a tick.

ranged.label: Ranged DPS
ranged.description: Followers first, then Faerlina. Spread out so a Rain of Fire only hits a few people, and step out of any fire under you.

healer.label: Healer
healer.description: Clean Poison Bolt Volley off the raid as it lands. Your button also stands in for the raid's Priests sacrificing a Worshipper: when she Enrages, press Dispel straight away, because the tank cannot survive long.

taunt.label: Taunt
taunt.tip: Taunt forces the boss onto you for a few seconds and puts you on top of the threat table. Press it the moment the boss turns on the raid, never while it is already on you.

attack.label: Attack
attack.tip: Attacks generate threat. Stop when the threat bar turns red so the boss stays on the tank.

heal.label: Heal the tank
heal.tip: A large heal for the tank. Time it to land with the incoming damage.

dispel.label: Dispel / Embrace
dispel.tip: Cures Poison Bolt Volley, and when she Enrages, it stands in for the Priest's Mind Control and Widow's Embrace: press it to remove the Enrage. Removes the oldest removable debuff, so clear poisons as they land to keep Enrage on top.

followerOne.label: Naxxramas Follower
followerOne.tip: Followers die first. The off-tank takes one and holds it near the raid.

worshippers.label: Naxxramas Worshippers
worshippers.tip: Four Worshippers in the corner. Never attack them: each one is a removal of her Enrage.

poisonBolt.label: Poison Bolt Volley
poisonBolt.tip: Poison on about a quarter of the raid. Healers clean it, everyone else keeps their health up.

rainFire.label: Rain of Fire
rainFire.tip: Fire on the ground. Step out at once.

rainOnTank.label: Rain of Fire on her
rainOnTank.tip: Rain of Fire on the melee. Drag her clear of it straight away.

enrageBoss.label: Enrage
enrageBoss.tip: She is enraged. Sacrifice a Worshipper now.

enrageDeb.label: Enrage
enrageDeb.tip: Enrage on the tank! Press Dispel to sacrifice a Worshipper and remove it now.

expectations.label: Pull her to the west side
expectations.tip: Drag her away from the Followers and Worshippers before the DPS arrive.

expectations.label: Pick up a Follower
expectations.tip: Run to it or Taunt it before it gets to the raid.

expectations.label: Hold the Follower near the raid
expectations.tip: Keep it next to where the DPS can reach it, away from the healers.

expectations.label: Step out of Rain of Fire
expectations.tip: Every tick is more than 2,000 on cloth. Step out the moment you see fire under you.

expectations.label: Followers first
expectations.tip: Every attack on her before the Followers are dead is wasted.

expectations.label: Spread out
expectations.tip: Keep the gaps so a single Rain of Fire only catches one or two people.

expectations.label: Stay in range of the tank, spread out
expectations.tip: Stay inside 40 yards of the tank at the west side.

expectations.label: Keep the tank alive
expectations.tip: She hits hard even before she enrages, so keep the tank topped.

expectations.label: Keep the tank above half
expectations.tip: If she enrages with the tank low the tank dies.

expectations.label: Clean Poison Bolt Volley fast
expectations.tip: Cleanse, Cure Poison, Poison Cleansing Totem. It ticks for ten seconds on everyone it hits.

expectations.label: Never pull aggro off the tank
expectations.tip: Stop attacking while the threat bar is red. Resume when it leaves the red band.

expectations.label: Keep her on the west side
expectations.tip: Leave her where she is unless Rain of Fire forces a step.

expectations.label: Drag her out of the fire
expectations.tip: Melee and you stand in it if she does. Take her a few steps clear.

expectations.label: Hold the Worshippers in the corner
expectations.tip: They must stay alive and far from everyone.

expectations.label: Step out of Rain of Fire
expectations.tip: Every tick is more than 2,000 on cloth. Step out the moment you see fire under you.

expectations.label: Sacrifice a Worshipper on Enrage
expectations.tip: She Enrages about once a minute. Press Dispel to sacrifice a Worshipper the moment it happens; keep poison off the list first.

expectations.label: Keep the tank alive
expectations.tip: She hits hard even before she enrages, so keep the tank topped.

expectations.label: Keep the tank above half
expectations.tip: If she enrages with the tank low the tank dies.

expectations.label: Clean Poison Bolt Volley fast
expectations.tip: Cleanse, Cure Poison, Poison Cleansing Totem. It ticks for ten seconds on everyone it hits.

expectations.label: Never pull aggro off the tank
expectations.tip: Stop attacking while the threat bar is red. Resume when it leaves the red band.

threatLostCount.label: Times the boss turned on the raid

aggroPulls.label: Times you pulled aggro
aggroPulls.tip: Stop attacking when the threat bar turns red.

attacksInRed.label: Attacks in the red band
attacksInRed.tip: Stop attacking in the red band so the tank can regain a threat lead.

earlyAttacks.label: Attacks before the tank had the boss
earlyAttacks.tip: Give the tank a few seconds after the pull.

dpsIdle.label: Seconds not attacking when you could
dpsIdle.tip: Keep attacking when it's safe. Stop if the threat bar turns red or the boss leaves the tank.

playerInHazard.label: Seconds standing in something bad
playerInHazard.tip: Move out of the ground effect before attacking again.

tankLowSeconds.label: Seconds with the tank under half
tankLowSeconds.tip: Top the tank up before the spike lands, not after.

overheals.label: Wasted heals
overheals.tip: Avoid healing the tank at full health. Save the heal for incoming damage.

debuffSeconds.label: Seconds with a dispellable debuff up

attacksOffPriority.label: Boss attacks while a priority add was alive
attacksOffPriority.tip: Face the add and kill it first. The boss can wait.

whelpsOnRaid.label: Adds loose on the raid
whelpsOnRaid.tip: Grab the adds before they reach a raid member and keep them on you.

cues.notes: Dispel poison and Enrage; pick up the Follower; heal the Enrage spike.

list.label: Taunt when Faerlina turns on the raid
list.tip: Taunt as soon as the boss turns toward the raid.

list.label: Heal the tank when they drop low
list.tip: The tank is below half health and a big hit is coming. Heal now.

list.label: Dispel it
list.tip: Dispel the moment it lands. Tank first, then healers, then everyone else.

list.label: Pick up the Follower
list.tip: Run to it or Taunt it.

drills.name: Drag her out of the fire
drills.description: Rain of Fire lands under her every 14 seconds. Step her clear each time.

drills.name: Step out of the fire
drills.description: Rain of Fire under you or next to you every 8 seconds. Step out and keep going.

drills.name: Enrage and the sacrifice
drills.description: She Enrages every 22 seconds and poison lands on the raid. Press Dispel on every Enrage straight away, then clean the poison.

drills.name: Pick up the Follower
drills.description: A Follower appears every 20 seconds. Get it on you and drag it to your spot.

limitations: Widow’s Embrace is a substitute dispel. There is no Worshipper mind control, sacrifice or Nature-school lockout.
